# Bay Area Accounting Solutions

> Full-range accounting firm in Fremont, California serving businesses and individuals across all 50 states: bookkeeping, tax preparation and planning, payroll, accounting cleanup, business formation, and registered agent services.

## Services

- [Bookkeeping & Accounting](https://bayareaaccountingsolutions.com/services/bookkeeping): Monthly books, reports and reconciliation
- [Business & Individual Taxes](https://bayareaaccountingsolutions.com/services/tax-services): Tax returns and year-round planning
- [Payroll Management](https://bayareaaccountingsolutions.com/services/payroll): Payroll, tax filings and year-end forms
- [Accounting Cleanup](https://bayareaaccountingsolutions.com/services/accounting): Rescue bookkeeping and audit-ready books
- [Business Formation & Consulting](https://bayareaaccountingsolutions.com/services/consulting): LLC, S-Corp and C-Corp setup
- [Registered Agent](https://bayareaaccountingsolutions.com/services/registered-agent): State compliance and legal notices
- [Bookkeeping Cleanup & Catch-Up](https://bayareaaccountingsolutions.com/services/bookkeeping-cleanup): Fix messy QuickBooks and catch up
- [For Contractors](https://bayareaaccountingsolutions.com/services/contractors): Job costing, payroll and 1099s
- [Foreign-Owned LLC Accounting](https://bayareaaccountingsolutions.com/services/foreign-owned-llc-accounting): Form 5472, FBAR, U.S. company registration and visa-ready financials for non-resident founders
- [Rush Service](https://bayareaaccountingsolutions.com/rush-service): Urgent deadlines, next-business-day options
